reader.notes: The Uniform row screens every position of the variadic list, so a bad operand anywhere is refused; ALL-subscripted numeric tables, including ODO tables at their current bound, are accepted and summed correctly. p_bad_sum at --std 2023 gives the same ten COBOL1627 lines.

refuter.evidence: Accept half (q_ok_forms-001): SUM(PIC PP9 0.004, PIC 9PP 400, ZEROS, ZEROES, +1) A5=401.004; SUM(TE(ALL) TE(2) FUNCTION ORD("A")) A8=70 (3+1+66); SUM(LINAGE-COUNTER 1 LINAGE-COUNTER) L2=7 and SUM(PAGE-COUNTER LINE-COUNTER 1) L3=2 (q_special_regs-003). SUM(NUM ALL ZERO) accepted, which §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.3 allows (ALL before a figurative constant other than ALL literal is redundant, so ALL ZERO is ZERO). Refuse half (q_bad_forms-001): SUM(PIC X table (ALL)) COBOL1627; SUM(numeric-edited table (ALL)) COBOL1627 numeric-edited; SUM(NUM group-table (ALL)) COBOL1627 argument-2 alphanumeric. Later forms (q_later_forms-001): SUM(1 PIC 9 USAGE NATIONAL) refused (COBOL0900 national requires 2002). cite.py: 'OK §1989:A.2.42.3 AR1'; 'OK §1989:A.2.2 AR1'; 'OK §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.3 (4.2.2.2.3 Figurative Constant Values) the text is in SRL3.3'.
